name: Letros
summary: Turns textbook photos, PDFs or Word files into interactive language lessons, live classes and homework checks for teachers and schools.
description: Letros is a web platform for language teachers and schools: classes, courses and homework in one place. You can turn a textbook photo, PDF or Word file into interactive exercises and check handwritten essays against Cambridge criteria. Students never pay. Every plan has every feature. Yearly billing is offered at 25% off. Official copy also says any plan is free until 31 December 2026, with no card. The legal name on the site is TOTORO TEACHER DOO BAR (Bar, Montenegro).

pricing.details: Free forever (up to 4 students); Teacher 11 €/month (up to 50 students); school plans 26 € / 48 € / 70 € / 106 € / 142 €/month (up to 20 / 50 / 100 / 200 / 300 students, unlimited teachers). Students never pay. Every plan has every feature. Yearly billing 25% off (yearly totals not published). Launch offer: any plan free until 31 December 2026, no card. Plus VAT where applicable.
